verses.text: Ha junel ayek' Jesús t'a sti' ha' nhajab' Genesaret. Tzijtum anima ix k'och t'ay, ix te witz'k'aj yuj heb' yujto snib'ej heb' syab' slolonel Dios.
Ix yilani ayek' chab' yunetak barco t'a sti' ha', malaj mach ayoch t'a yool, yujto ix elta juntzanh heb' yamum chay t'a yol te', wan sjuk'anel schimpa heb', yik syamlab' chay chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och Jesús t'a yol jun te' barco chi', haton te' yik winhaj Simón. Ix yalan t'a winh to snitzoch jab'ok te' winh t'a yol ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojan t'a yol te', ix och ijan sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' t'a sti' ha'.
Ixlajwi sk'ayb'an heb', ix yalanpax t'a winhaj Simón chi': --Koyek yet' te' he barco tik b'aj te jul ha', hata' ol eyak'em he chimpa, xchi Jesús chi'.
--Ach ko k'ayb'umal, jun ak'wal ix kak'lej ko yaman nok' k'ik'i, malaj wal junok nok' ix kik'a'. Palta yujnhej to a ach tzala', ol b'at kak'em ko chimpa tik junelxo, xchi winhaj Simón chi' t'ay.
Haxo yik ix yak'anem heb', manhxo jantakok nok' ix yamchaji. Ha schimpa heb' chi' ijan ix nhik'chajb'ati.
Ix sb'echk'ab'ankot juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum heb' t'a junxo barco yik tz'och heb' yet' heb'. Ix jawi heb', ix b'ut'ji chab' te' barco chi'. Ijan ix b'at te' t'a yol ha' yuj yalil nok'.
Haxo ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Simón Pedro chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ma max ach el t'a in tz'ey, yujto a in tik, te chuk in, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix yutej winh yalani, yujto ix te sat sk'ol winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum yuj juntzanh nok' tzijtumal chay ix syam heb' chi'.

Hanhejtona' winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj Juan, haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zebedeo, ix te sat sk'ol heb' winh. Yetyamum chayil sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Simón chi'. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winhaj Simón chi': --Manh ach xiwok. Icha tzutej a yaman nok' chay tik, icha chi' ol utok ik'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo ix elk'och juntzanh barco chi' t'a sti' ha', ix yaktankan juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' chi', ix och tzak'an heb' yuj Jesús.

Ha junel ayek' Jesús t'a jun chonhab', ix k'och jun winh t'ay, ayk'e yab'il lepra t'a sniwanil winh smasanil. Ha ix yilanoch Jesús chi' winh, ix em kumnaj winh, ix em nhojnaj winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan winh t'ay: --Mamin, ta syal a k'ool tzin a b'oxikani, xchi winh.
Haxo Jesús ix yamlan winh, ix yalani: --In gana sb'oxikan a k'ool, xchi t'a winh. Ayik ix yalan Jesús icha chi', ix el jun yab'il chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix cham wal yalan t'a winh: --Ayta b'aj tzal jun tik. Palta ixik, b'at ch'ox a b'a t'a winh sacerdote. B'at ak'an jun silab' t'a Dios, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés, yik tz'ilji to ach b'oxi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Ha yab'ixal Jesús chi', ix pukaxnhej t'a skal heb' anima. Tzijtum heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a yik syab' heb' tas syala', yik sb'oxikan sk'ol heb' yuj.
Ix yik'el sb'a t'a skal heb', ix b'at lesal b'aj malaj heb' anima.

T'a jun k'u wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima Jesús, k'ojk'umb'a juntzanh heb' fariseo yet' pax heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ha t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Galilea yet' t'a yol yik Judea ix laj kot heb'. Ay pax heb' ix kot t'a Jerusalén. Haxo Jesús ix cheklajel spoder Dios t'ay, ayik ix yak'an b'oxok sk'ol heb' penaay.
Ichato chi' ix k'och juntzanh heb' winh, b'akhb'il jun winh sikb'inakel yuj heb' winh yet' swaynub'. Snib'ej heb' winh tz'och t'a yol pat syak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús.

Palta maj ilchajlaj yuj heb' winh b'aj tz'ochi yujto te witz'an yuj heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix k'e heb' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh jun pat chi', ix yolan yib'anh pat chi' heb' winh, ix yak'anemta winh penaay chi' heb' winh yet' swaynub' t'a skal heb' anima t'a yichanh Jesús chi'.
Haxo ix yilan Jesús chi' to ix yak'och sk'ool heb' winh t'ay, yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh penaay chi': --Ach anima, toxo ix ak'ji lajwok a mul, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi', haxo heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' fariseo, ix och ijan heb' snaub'tanhani: ¿Tas yaj jun winh tik? Wan sb'uchwaj winh t'a Dios. Malaj junok mach syal yak'an lajwok mul, anhej Dios, xchi heb' t'a spensar.
Palta a Jesús yojtakxo tas wan snaan heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tze naub'tanhej jun tik?
¿Tas junok sekojtak kalan tze na'a? ¿A a mul toxo ix ak'ji lajwok, xko chama, ma: K'eanh waan, b'eyanh, mato xko chi?

Ha tiknaik, ol in ch'ox t'ayex to a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ay wopisio wak'an lajwok smul heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh sikb'inakel chi': --Ha in tik swal t'ayach, k'eanh waan, ik'chaanh a waynub' tik, ixik t'a a pat, xchi t'a winh.
T'a jun rato chi', ix k'e waan winh sikb'inakel chi' t'a yichanh heb'. Ix yik'anchaanh swaynub' winh b'aj jichan ek' chi'. Ix pax winh t'a spat, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios.
Ix laj och k'elan heb' smasanil ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios, ix te sat sk'ol heb', yuj chi' ix laj yal heb': --Ix te sat ko k'ool kilan juntzanh tik, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta Jesús, ix yilan jun winh tekumel alkabar skuchan Leví, k'ojanek' winh b'aj stekel alkabar chi'. Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Ochanh in k'ayb'umok, xchi.
Ix k'e waan winh, ix yaktankan smasanil, ix och winh sk'ayb'umok Jesús chi'.
Ichato chi', ix och jun niwan wael t'a spat winh yik swa Jesús yet'ok. Tzijtum heb' winh tekumel alkabar yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima ix och yet' heb' t'a mexa.

Haxo heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzex wa'i, tzeyuk'an ha' yet' juntzanh heb' winh tekumel alkabar tik yet' heb' chuk sb'eyb'al tik? xchi heb' winh t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yal Jesús t'a heb' winh: --K'inalok ay junok winh anhtum tiknaik. Ha heb' wach' sk'ool, ¿tom ay tz'och winh yuj heb'? Anhej heb' penaay ay tz'och winh yuj.
Manh yujok wawtan heb' toxon wach' sb'eyb'al snaani, in jawi. Palta yuj wawtan heb' yojtak to chuk sb'eyb'al, yik wach' sna sb'a heb' yuj smul, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a Jesús: --Ha heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan, winh tz'ak'an bautizar yet' heb' sk'ayb'um heb' winh fariseo, tzijtum el tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, slesalwi heb'. Palta haxo heb' a k'ayb'um tik, ¿tas yuj anhej wael syak' heb'? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --K'inalok ay junok nupnajel, ¿tom syal eyak'anoch heb' awtab'il t'a nupnajel chi' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yakb'an aytoek' winh wan yoch yetb'eyum chi' yet' heb'?
Palta ol ja sk'ual ol ik'jok el winh t'a skal heb', ichato chi' ol och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi junxo ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh: --Malaj junok onh ay junok ak' pichul sko nhik'elta jab'ok, skak'anoch snipulok junok k'a pichul. Tato icha chi' skutej, tz'ixtaxel jun ak'to chi'. Hanhejtona', tz'ixtax pax el jun k'a pichul chi' yuj jun ak'to chi'.
Ol wal junxo ch'oxnab'il: Max yal-laj yak'chajem wino manto sipji t'a yol junok nok' k'a tz'um yet'tal wino, tato icha chi', snhik'chaj jun tz'uum chi' yuj wino chi', tz'ixtax scha makanhil.
Yuj chi', ha t'a yol nok' ak' tz'uum tzeyak'em wino manto sipji, icha chi' wach' ol kan schab'il.
Hanhejtona', tato ay heb' hanheja' tzato uk'an peka' wino, haxo jun wino toto sb'oi, malaj yelk'och t'a sat heb'. Syalan heb': Ha jun peka' wino tik, más wach', xchi heb', xchi Jesús.
